most_relevant.description: Visited for IISC open day. It was a great exposure for kids and adults too to explore the application of science in various fields. Need a complete day to explore every department. Participants were explaining with great enthusiasm and activeness. Volunteers are guiding along the way. Food, water is available at dedicated centers. The campus is maintained neat inspite of so many visitors. A must visit to people interested in science and aspiring science grads.

Had a wonderful experience on the campus. It feels like a botanical garden in itself. I really enjoyed walking around and soaking in the surroundings. The campus is filled with a wide variety of trees, including sandalwood, jackfruit, beautiful flowering plants, and several species from different parts of the world.

My YouTube channel: "Jai RC". Please do like and subscribe to my channel

Had a great experience attending the 2-day Drone Technology Workshop at Indian Institute of Science. The workshop included both theory and hands-on practical sessions covering drone basics, assembly, and working mechanisms. Very informative, futuristic, and inspiring. The IISc campus was calm, green, neat, and beautiful. Good mess and restaurant facilities added to the comfort. Overall, a well-organized and valuable learning experience.

IISc Bangalore is not just a college—it is a dream destination for science students, especially those passionate about research and innovation. If your goal is to pursue Physics, Engineering, or advanced scientific research, IISc is one of the best places in India.

The Indian Institute of Science (IISc) Bangalore is one of the finest institutions for higher education and research in India. The campus is beautiful, green, and exceptionally well maintained. The faculty members are highly knowledgeable, and the research facilities and laboratories are world-class. The academic environment encourages innovation, critical thinking, and collaboration. The staff is professional and supportive, making the overall experience excellent. I highly recommend IISc to anyone looking for top-quality education and cutting-edge research opportunities.
